name: Antonio Arena
collection: New York, New York City Births, 1846-1909
note: The tree has him born 1895 in New York and the 1900 census gives October 1895 with an age of five. The birth register says 4 OCTOBER 1896. Day and month agree; the year differs by one, and the birth register is the primary record.

name: Sarafina Arena
parents: Rocco Arena and Generosa Costa Arena
collection: New York, New York City Births, 1846-1909
note: NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. She died at Manhattan on 30 JANUARY 1900 and was buried the next day, aged seventeen months -- which is why she is absent from the 1900 census taken that June. AND SHE IS NAMED FOR HER PATERNAL GRANDMOTHER: act 228 of 1861 gives Rocco Arena's mother as SERAFINA ARLOTTA. A quiet third corroboration of the parentage, arrived at from New York rather than from Scilla.

name: Clementina Arena
parents: Rocco Arena and Generosa Costa Arena

name: Antonino Arena
collection: New York, New York City Births, 1846-1909
note: NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. A second son on the Antonio root; his elder brother Antonio was alive in 1900, so this is an additional child rather than a reused name.
